name: tetranoid
description: Fan-art mashup of two beloved games, as an installable offline PWA with no build step

scripts.og: npx -y playwright@1 screenshot --viewport-size=1200,630 --wait-for-timeout=500 "file://$PWD/tools/og-banner.html" src/icons/og-image.png && npx -y pngquant-bin@9 --quality=70-90 --speed 1 --strip --force --output src/icons/og-image.png src/icons/og-image.png
